note: Hard B, lineage reading: base.json names this recipe's mother, so the declared difference is against that recipe -- not against the framework stock cfg, which would bury this version's own delta in everything its ancestors wrote. Env paths are grouped by who wrote them: the element set that touched the path (several elements can touch one path in sequence), a version-resolved component, or wiring -- the shared wiring reading this recipe's own document. params_version is filtered as identity: it says which recipe this is, and it is what makes the two recipes different at all.

v0_curriculum_actions.why: the deployed legs/spine split replaces the flat root's single joint_pos term, so the spine can be gated; the spine scale comes from the dev yaml

v0_curriculum_stage0_ranges.why: the initial command ranges mirror stage 0, so a fresh env is not resampled off-spec in its first episode

v0_curriculum_stages.why: the three staged curricula (bone/speed/turning) that replace the fixed command ranges; the stage lists stay in curriculum_env_cfg

allowed.experiment_name: one recipe, one log directory (versioning.mdc A): lizard_curriculum_flat against the flat root's lizard_flat
